name: Foldaway
summary: Paper code tiles that fold onto each other and turn over into one check mark
about: A 4-digit one-time code field drawn on lined note paper, with tiles that have a folded corner. When the right code is entered the tiles fold one by one onto the first, slide to the middle and turn over to show a check. Good for login checks, two-step verification and phone confirmation.
how: Type, paste or autofill the demo code; backspace and arrow keys move between tiles
Each filled tile turns teal so you can see your progress
With the right code the tiles fold from right to left like a paper strip
The folded stack slides to the centre and flips over into a check mark
A wrong code makes the paper rustle in coral and clears the tiles
